author: Rachel Clarkin
text: Check your insurance durable medical benefit. My rx plan did not cover them and I was paying out of pocket with a copay card from Abbott to bring the cost down for 18 months.  Then during a call to my insurance company I asked how do people with insulin pumps do it? That’s when the lightbulb went off and the rep looked at my medical durable benefit. They won’t offer that info, you have to ask the right questions. Durable medics like if you needed a walker or wheelchair, but apparently cgm are in that same category. I wish I knew that 18 months ago.
